source_basis: Masoretic Hebrew text of Ruth 1 independently verified from Sefaria/Mechon-Mamre
OSHB/WLC production source lock still required in repository workflow

important_decisions.rendering: the LORD had attended to his people by giving them food
important_decisions.note: Hebrew paqad has a range including attend to/visit/take notice of; review against TSW lexical policy.
Key thematic term in Ruth; preserve across 1:8, 2:20, 3:10 unless context requires otherwise.

important_decisions.rendering: rest in the home of a husband
important_decisions.note: Rest can carry security/home implications; main text preserves the image rather than replacing it with explanation.

important_decisions.rendering: the hand of the LORD has gone out against me
important_decisions.note: Preserve Naomi's own interpretation and the concrete biblical image.
The verb is thematically significant; do not soften to merely stayed.
Hebrew אלהיה can be read numerically plural or, contextually, as a singular divine reference. Review against current TSW.

important_decisions.rendering: Where you go, I will go ...
important_decisions.note: Retain covenantal/oath force without turning Ruth's speech into explanatory prose.
Traditional 'Almighty' is interpretive and the etymology is uncertain. Review whether Fluent should teach the divine name directly.

important_decisions.rendering: the LORD has testified against me
important_decisions.note: Preserves Naomi's legal metaphor and her perspective rather than converting it to narrator theology.
Preserve repeated shuv/return language even though English style might prefer variation.

apparatus_policy: No public Notes/Vocabulary inserted yet because canonical shared TSW apparatus for Ruth 1 was not recovered. Proposed apparatus remains in this review ledger until Core reconciliation.
